news.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
news.summary: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

news.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
news.summary: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

news.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
news.summary: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

news.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
news.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

news.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
news.summary: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

news.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
news.summary: The Bitmine chairman said he expects younger investors to drive demand for digital assets as his ether treasury company inches closer to owning 5% of the total supply.

news.title: Tokenized catastrophe bonds target the disaster-insurance gap
news.summary: A planned Bermuda issuance would put legal ownership onchain and seek capital for disaster risks that remain costly to insure.

news.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
news.summary: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

news.title: The global economy is starting to look K-shaped. Here are the winners and losers, and where the U.S. fits.
news.summary: IMF sees a split global economy, with countries less exposed to the oil shock and benefiting from AI demand pulling ahead

news.title: The SpaceX threat could loom over AT&T’s stock for a prolonged stretch, analyst cautions
news.summary: Bernstein analyst Laurent Yoon no longer recommends any of the major telecommunications stocks as he warns of more volatility ahead.

news.title: ‘The house is worth $925,000’: My sister moved in with our mother, 78, and says she deserves the family home. Is she right?
news.summary: “The house is worth $925,000 and mom owns it outright. She also has $480,000 in investments.”

news.title: ‘The prospectus looks impressive’: My financial adviser wants me to invest $350,000 in a UAE data center. Is this risky?
news.summary: “I’m in my 60s, recently retired and living my best life.”

news.title: Investors worry the bull market is getting old. But history shows it can continue to age gracefully.
news.summary: Contrary to a widespread current worry among some on Wall Street, bull markets do not die of old age,

news.title: ‘I have no children’: My aunt gave me $50,000 for a down payment. Now she wants me to leave my home to her two children.
news.summary: “The house cost $385,000. With my savings, her $50,000 and a small mortgage, I was able to close.”

news.title: Brazilian stocks are breaking out as investors look for opportunities beyond tech
news.summary: Brazil’s presidential election is powering optimism in the country’s stock market — and capturing the attention of investors wary of having too much exposure to U.S. stocks.
